source: Escape from Tarkov Wiki (Fandom), the Guide sections of the story chapters

title.en: What do you do with the armored case?

note.en: Point of no return: this choice decides which endings of The Ticket stay open.
note.tr: Geri dönüşü yok: bu seçim The Ticket'ın hangi sonlarının açık kalacağını belirler.

label.en: Keep the armored case for yourself

rewards.en: +80,000 EXP · Prapor rep −0.7 · the Armored case · achievement "Just Business"
rewards.tr: +80.000 EXP · Prapor itibarı −0,7 · Zırhlı çanta · "Just Business" başarımı

label.en: Hand the armored case over to Prapor

rewards.en: +80,000 EXP · 1,000,000 roubles (1,050,000 with Intelligence Center 1, 1,150,000 with level 2) · achievement "Man of His Word"
rewards.tr: +80.000 EXP · 1.000.000 ruble (Intelligence Center 1 ile 1.050.000, 2 ile 1.150.000) · "Man of His Word" başarımı

label.en: Say you didn't find it, but still hand it over to Prapor
label.tr: Bulamadım de ama yine de Prapor'a ver

rewards.en: Same as handing it over: +80,000 EXP · 1,000,000 roubles · achievement "Man of His Word"
rewards.tr: Teslim etmekle aynı: +80.000 EXP · 1.000.000 ruble · "Man of His Word" başarımı

title.en: What do you do with the fragment of Item 1156?

note.en: The chapter goes on the same way after either answer; only the reward differs.
note.tr: Bölüm iki cevapta da aynı şekilde devam eder; sadece ödül değişir.

label.en: Hand the fragment over to Mechanic
